headline: Lowe's (LOW) Stock Looks Reasonable As Its 25% Five Year Gain Holds
summary: Lowe's Companies stock has delivered a 25.3% gain over the past five years, yet the current valuation picture is more measured. An intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model points to shares that look roughly in line with fair value, while traditional multiples still indicate some room on the upside.
